activity_summary: You came out of Egeon. It was the second time this week. Garnish said nothing was bought and that the K had not been carried into the performance. You went toward home with tomorrow still to write, and with no total.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came out of the part and refused a total.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Noted it was the second Egeon of the week.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Kept the K out of the performance and reported nothing bought.
